| Rule | Catches | Enable via |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [comment-discipline](comment-discipline.md) | Top-level narrative, multiline comments, adjacent groups; keeps one-line whys beside code | `configs.recommended` |
| [no-broken-relative-links](no-broken-relative-links.md) | Relative Markdown links to untracked paths | `@house-rules/rules/markdown` |
| [design-no-raw-color](design-no-raw-color.md) | Raw hex, rgb(), hsl(), etc. in CSS | `design()` factory |
| [design-no-raw-color-literal](design-no-raw-color-literal.md) | Raw hex, rgb(), hsl(), etc. in JS/TS strings | `design()` factory |
| [design-no-unknown-token](design-no-unknown-token.md) | `var(--name)` with no definition | `design()` factory |
| [design-scale-value](design-scale-value.md) | CSS values off a fixed scale | `design()` factory |
| [shadcn/*](shadcn.md) | Restyled design-system components, raw palette colours, arbitrary values, inline styles, dynamic class names, and unknown Tailwind classes in JSX and TSX | `shadcn()` factory |
| [use-case-is-capability](use-case-is-capability.md) | A use-case file that does not export exactly one `implement(...)` capability, exports a second contract, or exports another value | `configs.capability` |
| [no-hand-rolled-surface](no-hand-rolled-surface.md) | `Tool.make`, `Rpc.make`, or `HttpApiEndpoint.<method>` outside `packages/capability/**` | `configs.capability` |
| [no-hand-run-effect](no-hand-run-effect.md) | `Effect.run*` or `ManagedRuntime.make` in a test file; tests use `it.effect` or `it.layer` | `configs.capability` |
